findings.summary: billable_hours subtracts timezone-aware start/end in the same zone as wall-clock times, ignoring DST offset changes, so sessions crossing a DST switch are overbilled (spring forward) or undercounted (fall back); should convert to UTC before subtracting.

judge.reason: Identifies same-zone aware datetime subtraction ignoring DST offset, fix via UTC conversion.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: The new tests have no session crossing a daylight-saving switch, so they don't catch the billing bug; a DST-crossing test case should be added.

judge.reason: Finding that tests don't cover the DST bug is always valid_other.

findings.label: valid_other
